1.web: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
1.asv: God is our refuge and strength, A very present help in trouble.

2.web: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;
2.asv: Therefore will we not fear, though the earth do change, And though the mountains be shaken into the heart of the seas;

3.web: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.
3.asv: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, Though the mountains tremble with the swelling thereof. [Selah

4.web: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.
4.asv: There is a river, the streams whereof make glad the city of God, The holy place of the tabernacles of the Most High.

5.web: God is in her midst. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.
5.asv: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God will help her, and that right early.

6.web: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice, and the earth melted.
6.asv: The nations raged, the kingdoms were moved: He uttered his voice, the earth melted.

7.web: Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
7.asv: Jehovah of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our refuge. [Selah

8.web: Come, see Yahweh’s works, what desolations he has made in the earth.
8.asv: Come, behold the works of Jehovah, What desolations he hath made in the earth.

9.web: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.
9.asv: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; He breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; He burneth the chariots in the fire.

10.web: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.”
10.asv: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.

11.web: Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
11.asv: Jehovah of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our refuge. [Selah
